difference: Unlike r404 companion OPERATOR_SPECTRAL/RESTATEMENT, no Cholesky factor or finite Gram positivity is identified with an Euler/Digamma source; the asserted map is tested directly against exact spectra. The r399 CIRCULAR Weyl-energy decay route is not reused: no sub-quadratic-mean prime estimate is assumed. Existing natural torsion/UCP and parabolic determinant-line normalization obstructions remain in force; this tests a different coherent corner tower, not their revival. Graph gaps and no non-killed gaussian-e8-module -> weil-positivity path were checked.
method: Compare complete point spectra using the invariant finite-dimensional tower and the exact irreducible nonintegral monic source polynomial; do not infer process identity from group faithfulness.
next_test: Prove that a cofinal nested exhaustion by invariant finite stages gives a complete root-of-unity eigenbasis, independently reconstruct source and exterior-square characteristic polynomials, then require the same state intertwiner for the full Gauss charge-square generator and readers only if the spectral gate passes.
object: For the exact original U,V in SU(3,Q(i)), W=UV, and the vacuum-normalized odd p-adic Weil representation R_odd on tensor'_{p odd}(L2(Q_p^3),Omega_p), seek nonzero linear J:C^3 -> H_odd with R_odd(W)J=JW; also test J:Lambda^2(C^3 direct-sum C)->H_odd for Lambda^2(W direct-sum 1).
obligations: Retain the exact odd-tower representation and its source-declared vacuum phase.
Use a dense cofinal exhaustion and invariant orthogonal differences, not just finitely many eigenvalue samples.
Verify irreducibility of 64*h(x/2) modulo 3 and the nonintegral coefficient 13/4 of monic h.
For a nonzero intertwiner, preserve each source eigenvalue on its image; show disjoint point spectra force J=0.
Do not identify this excluded exact map with the separate unchanged target-group representation or all possible approximate transfers.
scope: Exactly the existing fixed phase-normalized R_odd and exact linear finite-source state intertwiners, no approximations, no alternative enlarged representation. Each target finite stage has finite-order W. Source polynomial h=x^6-2x^5+(13/4)x^4-(7/2)x^3+(13/4)x^2-2x+1 is irreducible over Q and has no root of unity. The target concerns one necessary interface obligation, not completion of the general compactness target or RH.
stop_condition: Stop the exact source-embedding proposal if every linear J is zero. Preserve abstract group faithfulness and allow explicitly new carriers or controlled approximation proposals to be assessed separately. No RH, T1-T8 or factorization closure.
